slice: Natural conversation: fix awkward greeting + meta-referential replies (round 1)

reported_example.old_novi: Hello! I'm Novi, and it's nice to meet you. I noticed you greeted the system — I'm curious, what's on your mind today?
reported_example.reason: You just greeted me, so I replied warmly and briefly — no need to over-explain.

mechanism: pure greetings get a short warm reply; assistant openers ('what's on your mind', 'how can I help you today') are forbidden; meta-narration of the conversation is rejected; '[heard]' marker is stripped from LLM history
